primaryAssertions: S2 explicit learned reward ln3 and 0 -> Bradley-Terry probability 3/4 is distinct from DPO implicit reward
RLHF reward expectation minus beta KL remains symbolic, reference policy fixed, no full-response KL computed from residual aggregate
S5 two visible beta log Z(x-0) terms, S6 cancellation only for same input and visible pair loss distinct from expectation
reward-risk same output feeds proxy and separate assessment; no oracle true quality, numeric curve, optimum or guarantee; S1 verbosity AND appearance; S2 KL AND reassessment

feedback source and granularity are separate axes, process may use human labels, no universal four-cell compatibility matrix, outcome final1/process intermediate3 on same answer, labels human/AI at S4 only, no safety guarantee

dpo.source: literal fractions and closed forms below; browser expected values must not import product model
dpo.displayRule: Approximate numeric labels use ≈ and 3 decimals; keep exact ratio/formula labels nearby. Tests compare unrounded data values and rounded visible values separately.
dpo.wholeLoss: Displayed numerical loss is one pair ell = -ln sigma(m). Full L_DPO is an expectation / empirical average over preference pairs.
dpo.klRule: Pair probabilities and unknown other-response mass cannot determine the original full-response KL. Never compute a 3-cell aggregate KL and label it the original objective.

coverage.phaseRule: Each boundary k+.49/.5/.51 forward and reverse; primary labels, numerical data, SVG and highlighted links agree on shared clock midpoint
coverage.nonactiveRule: beta effective1 before S4; labelSource effectivehuman before S4; changing one figure does not mutate the other two
coverage.allImages: 15 stages * 6 profiles, viewport plus complete-scene PNG; independent actual-size glyph/overlap/wire review required
coverage.nativePlayback: real elapsed time per figure; pause freezes semantic and numeric state; replay resets; last stage completes; invisible/offscreen stops where existing common test applies
coverage.source: 9 H3/4 display math/1 original Mermaid and original corrected article AST retained. Public DPO 390 light/dark retains role=region/tabindex/focus-visible/arrow access to both ends/fraction height/page overflow checks within screen cases; local math.spec remains active
